_doc: THE DECLARED TUNING REGISTER — THE PEN'S FILE.
This file is DECLARED. Its sibling tests/lint/.tuning-inventory.json is MEASURED and is
written by the refreeze ritual alone. Never hand-edit a measured field; never hand-edit
THE VALUES IN THE ESTATE ARE NOT THIS FILE'S TO CHANGE. Every row lands `draft`, and a
row becomes `signed` only through the ritual, driven by a signing record the OWNER wrote
at the tuning sitting. `signatureVersion` is 0 until then. A lane that wants a different
value opens an owner row; it does not edit here.

a scalar dial imported by name; its consumers read it as a computed leaf.

the power desk's five reader-facing cuts. Module-private scalars the _TUNING glob cannot see, indexed by roster exactly as faithChannelBindings.js#CAUSAL_SWING is. Deliberately NOT exported: a register row is never a reason to widen a module's public surface.
the condition desk's wind-down cut, one module-private scalar indexed by roster.

the economy desk's two income-concentration cuts. Module-private scalars the _TUNING glob cannot see, indexed by roster exactly as faithChannelBindings.js#CAUSAL_SWING is. Deliberately NOT exported: a register row is never a reason to widen a module's public surface. HIGH_RUNG_FROM and LOW_RUNG_TO in the same file are equally reader-facing and are deliberately NOT here — they sit at the figure the inventory already banked, so registering them is a TIGHTENING act rather than this lane's blocker cure. Owed, not forgotten.

the general desk's food-deficit cut, one module-private scalar indexed by roster. It is the only row in this register whose value MIRRORS a second, unregistered literal in the producer — see the row's own note.

moduleSideCitation: §725.1 — the owner ruled no map leg in launch tuning at all; every map constant is module-side. These ids are enrolled by totality but are REFUSED `signed` and never reach the sitting's desk.

src/domain/spatial/modeSpeeds.js#KM_SCAL.note: WY-1 THE SCALE CHARTER (FP lane FP-W; docs/DESIGN_FP_ARCH_WY.md §8, J-D11(b) activated): the default km scale, km per map-coordinate unit, for a map that exposes no scale of its own. PROPOSED = 3, FMG's own default distance scale (public/map distanceScaleInput value 3, km per pixel). Read ONLY by the creation flow's seam modeSpeeds.creationKmScale; no canonize applies it by itself, so the wave stays dark until the creation flow ships the datum. UNIT `mixed`: the unit is km per map unit, and the closed vocabulary has no distance word, so the compound is declared `mixed` rather than coerced. DRAFT — registering is not signing; the owner signs it with MODE_SPEED_TUNING at the sitting.

src/domain/spatial/modeSpeeds.js#MODE_SP.note: WY-1 THE SCALE CHARTER (FP lane FP-W; docs/DESIGN_FP_ARCH_WY.md §8, J-D11(b)'s one mode-speed table): MODE_SPEEDS, km per week for the closed mode set foot | cart | river | coastal | sea. PROPOSED foot 150 (a walker's ~21 km a day), cart 110, river 280, coastal 450, sea 900 — raw-authored, unsoaked. DATA-GATED by spatialDigest.kmScale (decoupled from the port program's flag): an unscaled world never reads it. `foot` is the base denomination every mover inherits through distanceRead.hopWeeks; a caller names another mode explicitly. UNIT `mixed`: km per week is a compound unit and the closed vocabulary has no distance or speed word, so it is declared `mixed` rather than coerced. DRAFT — registering is not signing; the owner-signing obligation of the war volume §7 parking row is unchanged.

src/domain/worldPulse/pactRenewal.js#REN.note: FP GR-5b THE RENEWAL WINDOW (lane FP-B3; ruling FP-15): the last weeks of an instrument's longest live clause in which either court may ask to renew it, on the 52-week clock. PROPOSED = 26. FLOOR: the far court's answer, two legs of the real road plus the deliberation (pactProposals.js answerDueTickFor), measured over real digests of four realm sizes: longest answer 8 / 12 / 18 / 22 weeks at 9 / 20 / 40 / 80 seats, so a renewal asked on the window's first day is answered while the instrument lives. CEILING: below the shortest clause either door mints, 52 weeks (the war door's one-year affordability floor, 21 of 117 clauses over 60 lit mints; peacetime drafts run 156 to 416). DRAFT, registered by the lane's builder seat; the owner signs it at the tuning sitting.

src/domain/worldPulse/envoyChanceMeeting.note: ENC-3's chance-meeting STAGE (§893.2), distinct from the leaf's CHANCE_MEETING_TUNING beside it. Three values, and the source's own provenance block already names all three as OWNER-UNSIGNED (§12 row 7): exposureGrievance is deliberately HALF corruptionWeb's EXPOSURE_GRIEVANCE_W (0.5) because an approach is smaller than a discovered leash; exposureCovertMultiplier doubles it for a covert face; residentImportanceFloor is the estate's existing 'notable' line, NOT a number this lane chose. Units derived, not guessed: exposureGrievance adds into a clamp01'd resentment scaled by a magnitude01 (envoyChanceMeetingStage.js:778, corruptionWeb.js:1119), and residentImportanceFloor mirrors npcGrowthKernel's IMPORTANCE_FLOOR: fraction01. DRAFT — registering is not signing.

src/domain/display/stateProse/powerState.note: DS-POW-2's NARROW cut. PROPOSED = 0.15, which is the value shipping today; this row moves nothing. EVIDENCE: governingSharePoolKey renders 'governing faction holds a NARROW plurality' when `governing.power - runnerUp <= governing.power * NARROW_MARGIN`, so the dial is a proportion OF THE GOVERNING FACTION'S OWN POWER rather than of the town's total — fraction01. The source's docblock marks it a vetoable JUDGMENT and records that the DS-POW-2 annex says only "by the smallest margin the town has" and leaves the cut to the implementer, so no canonical value was overridden. A share falling between DOMINANT and NARROW renders NOTHING by design. READER-FACING: this dial decides which of two sentences a paying customer reads about a town's power. DRAFT — registering is not signing.

DS-POW-3's shallow-ladder cut. PROPOSED = 3, the value shipping today. EVIDENCE: compared against `rungs.length` in ladderPoolKey, so it counts THINGS rather than naming a position — the distinction DEITY_FLAW_TUNING's WRATH_SHARPEN_RUNGS row draws in the other direction, where rungs are a rank. It is tested first because the two gap cuts below it are meaningless on two rungs. Vetoable JUDGMENT per the source: npcLadderState.js#LADDER_TUNING carries STAND_MAX and a baseline but no rung-count band, so there was no canonical cut to reuse. DRAFT — registering is not signing.

DS-POW-3's churn cut. PROPOSED = 0.35, the value shipping today. EVIDENCE: compared against the churn tax returned by ladderInstabilityOf (src/domain/townMap/ladderRead.js:138), which pushes its reading through `num01` and is documented "0..1, decaying" — fraction01, and NOT on LADDER_TUNING's raw STAND_MAX 0..10 scale. FOR THE SITTING, THE SHARPEST ROW HERE: 0.35 is byte-equal to npcLadderState.js#LADDER_TUNING.CHURN_BUMP (0.35, commented "per contested challenge this advance (win OR fail)"), so the desk calls a faction 'high instability (churn at the top)' on the strength of exactly ONE undecayed contested challenge. Whether that coupling is intended or coincidence is the owner's to say; this lane neither moved the value nor bound the two into a role. DRAFT — registering is not signing.

DS-POW-3's crowded-top cut. PROPOSED = 0.08, the value shipping today. EVIDENCE: `standing[0] - standing[1] <= CROWDED_TOP_GAP`, and ladderRungsOf (src/domain/townMap/ladderRead.js:95) normalises every standing through `num01` and documents "standing 0..1" — so this is a fraction01 gap on the NORMALISED reading and not on LADDER_TUNING's raw STAND_MAX 0..10. Vetoable JUDGMENT per the source, with no canonical band to reuse. DRAFT — registering is not signing.

DS-POW-3's settled-order cut. PROPOSED = 0.15, the value shipping today. EVIDENCE: every adjacent pair must satisfy `standing[i-1] - v >= SETTLED_MIN_GAP` over the same num01-normalised standings CROWDED_TOP_GAP reads — same population, same unit. FOR THE SITTING: it and CROWDED_TOP_GAP (0.08) are the two ends of ONE scale and are best read on one page. They are deliberately NOT bound into a role, because a role asserts ONE value and these are two different cuts by design. Its 0.15 equals NARROW_MARGIN's 0.15 by coincidence over a different population — also no role. DRAFT — registering is not signing.

src/domain/display/stateProse/stressorsS.note: DS-CND-1's wind-down window. PROPOSED = 0.25, the value shipping today. EVIDENCE: `remaining <= expires * WIND_DOWN_FRACTION` in conditionDurationPoolKey — a proportion of a condition's own expiry, dimensionless, so it is fraction01 and NOT a ticks dial. The source's docblock records that activeConditions.js carries SEVERITY_DRIFT_PER_TICK and expiry bookkeeping but NO wind-down boundary, so no canonical cut was overridden. DRAFT — registering is not signing.

src/domain/worldPulse/envoyChanceMeeting.note: ENC-4 (ROAD B): the Herald presentation of a recorded meeting — severity (the notable band's weight) and score; registered by the Fable chair at the §899 composed landing when the walker convicted the bare decimal in a new file. src/domain/display/stateProse/economySta.note: DS-ECO-12's sole-earner cut. PROPOSED = 50, which is the value shipping today; this row moves nothing. EVIDENCE: incomeMixPoolKey renders 'INCOME MIX: one source carries the town' when the LARGEST single `percentage` in the income roster is >= SOLE_EARNER_FROM, and `percentage` is a 0..100 PERCENT figure — src/pdf/lib/viewModelBodySlices.js#normalizeIncomeSources documents "percentage = 0..100", the economy generators write whole percents (65, 45, 35, 30, 28, 25, 22, 20, 18), and src/foundry/journalPages.js renders the same field with a literal '%'. ⚠ FOR THE SITTING, THE SHARPEST THING ON THIS ROW IS THE UNIT WORD, NOT THE VALUE: `share` is used elsewhere in this register on a 0..1 scale — the cap__share role groups an elite-bleed cap of 0.05 with an institution-tolerance cap of 0.5 — so this row carries a 0..100 scale under a word whose only precedent is 0..1. The fourteen-word vocabulary is CLOSED but nowhere DEFINED, and it offers no word that distinguishes the two scales (`fraction01` is wrong here, `score100` names the scale but calls a share a score). The collision is RECORDED rather than resolved: splitting or defining a finite vocabulary is not a lane's act. The source's docblock marks the cut a vetoable JUDGMENT and records that the DS-ECO-12 annex says only "one source carries the town" and leaves the number to the implementer, so no canonical value was overridden. READER-FACING: this dial picks which of three sentences a paying customer reads about a town's economy. ⛔ AND THE BOUNDARY IS MEASURED, NOT REASONED — THIS IS THE SHARPEST THING ON THIS DESK: because the cut is 50 and the comparison is `>=`, TWO EVEN SOURCES AT 50.0 EACH RENDER 'one source carries the town'. That is the monopoly sentence, printed for a perfectly even two-way split, and the pool's own C1 variant says the leader is "well past half" where 50.0 is exactly half. Driven live through incomeMixPoolKey at this commit, not inferred from the source. DRAFT — registering is not signing.

DS-ECO-12's leader cut — the lower end of the same ladder SOLE_EARNER_FROM tops. PROPOSED = 20, the value shipping today. EVIDENCE: the same largest-`percentage` reading in incomeMixPoolKey; a leader at or above LEADER_FROM but below SOLE_EARNER_FROM renders 'two or three sources between them', and anything below it renders 'a broad spread, no leader'. Same 0..100 percent population as SOLE_EARNER_FROM, so the same `share` scale caveat on that row applies here unchanged. ⚠ FOR THE SITTING: the cut is read off the LEADER ALONE and never off the roster's length, and the consequence is MEASURED rather than argued — driven live through incomeMixPoolKey, four even sources at 25.0 each and five at 20.0 each BOTH render "two or three sources between them", and 'a broad spread, no leader' cannot fire at all until SIX even sources at 16.7 each. The pool's words promise a count the cut never reads. Whether that is intended or is the cut standing in for a count the pool's own words promise is the owner's to say; this lane neither moved the value nor bound the two cuts into a role. They are deliberately NOT roled: a role asserts ONE value, and these are two ends of one ladder by design. DRAFT — registering is not signing.

src/domain/display/stateProse/generalSta.note: DS-GEN-6's food-deficit cut. PROPOSED = 0.05, the value shipping today; giving it a name moved nothing. EVIDENCE: `gap / need >= DEFICIT_FRACTION_FROM` in foodDeficitDimension, where the gap is the larger of a pre-import rawDeficit and a post-import residual and `need` is daily need — a ratio of two food quantities, dimensionless and 0..1, so fraction01. ⭐ THIS VALUE IS NOT THIS DESK'S ALONE, AND THE SITTING SHOULD KNOW IT BEFORE SIGNING: it MIRRORS the producer's own inline cut `gap / need >= 0.05` in generateSettlementReason (src/generators/narrativeGenerator.js), which computes hasFoodDeficit and persists nothing, so the desk has no canonical field to read and must re-derive. tests/domain/generalStateProseDesk.test.js pins the PRODUCER's literal through mustExtract and drives both sides of the boundary (4/100 reads 'no deficit', 5/100 reads 'deficit'), so the two cannot drift in silence — but they remain TWO literals in two trees, and only this one now has a register row. Signing this row alone would sign half of one value. The honest signature covers both sites, or the producer's literal earns a name and a row of its own first. DRAFT — registering is not signing.
